available: Available on the App Store and Google Play
intro: Five free tools to plan your sleep and wake-up routine. No account required. Your inputs stay in this browser.
nojs: Enable JavaScript to use the interactive controls. You can still read the guide and download WakeSharp.
question: Are these tools free and private?
answer: Yes. No account or payment is needed. Calculations run in your browser. Optional analytics never include your inputs or results.
warning: Keep this page open and your device awake. Browser alarms may not sound when the screen locks, the tab closes, or the device sleeps.
blocked: Audio is blocked. Check sound permissions and try again.
awake: Screen wake lock is unavailable. Keep your device awake manually.
cutoff: Latest time for 25% remaining at bedtime
range: Difference between longest and shortest night
invalid: Please check the values and try again.
consent: Allow optional website analytics? We count tool usage and download clicks, never your inputs or results.
qrHelp: Scan this code with your phone to open the right store. Already installed? The link can open WakeSharp.
freeNote: These website tools are free. The WakeSharp app requires a subscription. See pricing.

pages.title: Sleep Calculator
pages.description: Find bedtime or wake-up time from your sleep target. Compare seven, eight and nine hours with an adjustable time to fall asleep.
pages.method: Choose what to calculate, enter a time, and adjust your sleep target. We add time to fall asleep to the time asleep. Sleep cycles vary; this cannot predict your sleep stages or guarantee a refreshed morning.
pages.cta: Plan bedtime here. Make getting up a mission with WakeSharp.

pages.title: Online Alarm Clock
pages.description: Set a free alarm in your browser, test the sound, and see the countdown. Keep the page open and your device awake for it to ring.
pages.method: Choose the next alarm time and test the sound before starting. A past time means tomorrow. Your browser cannot guarantee an alarm when suspended. Always use an independent alarm for an important wake-up.
pages.cta: Need a phone alarm with a task before your morning counts? Try WakeSharp.

pages.title: Nap Timer
pages.description: Start a 10, 20 or 30 minute nap timer, or choose your own duration. Preview the sound and keep your device awake while you rest.
pages.method: Choose a duration and start the timer. It measures elapsed time, not time asleep. Pause, resume or stop whenever you need. Naps affect people differently; no duration guarantees freedom from grogginess.
pages.cta: Keep dismissing alarms and falling asleep again? Explore WakeSharp’s missions.

pages.title: Sleep Debt Calculator
pages.description: Compare seven nights of sleep with your personal target. See total shortfall, average sleep and variation without a recovery promise.
pages.method: For each night we add the hours below your chosen target. Hours above the target are shown separately. This arithmetic estimate is not a diagnosis, and extra sleep does not erase sleep loss on a fixed schedule.
pages.cta: Start with enough sleep. Use WakeSharp to support a consistent wake-up routine.

pages.title: Caffeine Cutoff Calculator
pages.description: Estimate caffeine remaining at bedtime using dose, timing and half-life. Explore earlier consumption without a guaranteed safe cutoff.
pages.method: Remaining caffeine = dose × 0.5^(hours / half-life). Five hours is an illustration, not your measured metabolism. The cutoff leaves 25% of a dose, not a safe threshold. A bedtime earlier than consumption means the next day.
pages.cta: Plan the evening here. Bring structure to the morning with WakeSharp.
